_comment: Hoenn & Seek 2.0 (part 7): alternating hint lines, rumors, field notes and weather forecasts.
Read by tools/hoenn/gen_hoenn_hints.py, which writes src/data/hoenn_hints.h (the tables
src/hoenn_hints.c reads), data/scripts/hoenn_hints.inc (one wrapper script per NPC, plus every
text) and swaps each listed NPC's script in its map.json for the wrapper. Re-runs are idempotent.
lines: reusable extra lines. kind is tip / story / rumor / forecast (documentation only, except
that rumor lines name a rumor and forecast lines show today's or tomorrow's forecast). 'if' is a
list of conditions that must all hold. Texts are word-wrapped by the generator; a list of strings
is one text box per string.
rumors: 'found' says when the player has found it (all conditions hold); NPCs then say 'after'
instead of 'before'. The field-notes researcher counts found rumors and gives the first unfound
rumor's 'notes' as a vague hint. Later parts add their own rumors here (roadmap rule).
npcs: the NPCs that get extra lines. A global toggle (VAR_HOENN_HINT_TOGGLE) flips on every talk
to one of them: one talk runs the NPC's own script, the next their first line whose conditions
hold (or their own script again if none does). always: true skips the toggle (the line, when one
holds, always comes first). 'index' picks the object when several share the script.
key (lane setup, Nov 27): every NPC after the first 55 needs a unique key (letters, digits, _);
its wrapper is HoennSeek_EventScript_Hint_<key>. The first 55 keep positional names: never move them.
forecasts: {map, if, text}. A forecast applies when the map's special-weather day is today or
tomorrow (STR_VAR_1 = TODAY / TOMORROW) and its conditions hold, and only in the region of the
map the player is in. Shown by forecast lines and by every TV (before its normal show). Only
forecast weather that matters: something rare depends on it (2.0-plan section 2f).
Conditions: {flag: F} {not_flag: F} {var: V, min: n} {var: V, below: n} {stamps_min: n}
{stamps_below: n} (Hoenn badges) {badges_min: n} {badges_below: n} (HnS's 16 badges)
{caught: SPECIES} {not_caught: SPECIES} {level_cap: true} (HnS's level cap option is on).

text: The DAY-CARE couple on ROUTE 34 will raise two POKéMON for you.
Leave two that get along, and one day they may find an EGG!
The BUG-CATCHING CONTEST in JOHTO's NATIONAL PARK runs every day.
Catch the best BUG POKéMON you can find and you might win a prize!

TIP_CLOCK.text: Did you know? The clock on the wall in any POKéMON CENTER lets you set the day and the time.

text: With the LEVEL CAP on, your POKéMON stop growing at the next GYM LEADER's level.
Every BADGE you win raises the cap a little.
Some POKéMON only come out when the weather turns.
Rainy days and stormy days bring out different faces in the grass!

TIP_REMINDER_JK.text: A man in BLACKTHORN CITY can make POKéMON remember moves they've forgotten.

TIP_NAMERATER_JK.text: The NAME RATER in GOLDENROD CITY can give your POKéMON a better nickname.

TIP_REMINDER_H.text: In FALLARBOR TOWN there's a MOVE REMINDER. He helps POKéMON remember forgotten moves.

TIP_NAMERATER_H.text: The NAME RATER in SLATEPORT CITY can change your POKéMON's nicknames.

text: A guru in MOSSDEEP CITY reads POKéMON's minds.
For STAR PIECES, he can bring out a POKéMON's hidden potential.
See the rocks south of ROUTE 41? There's a gap with a huge whirlpool in it.
Past it is the TIDAL STRAIT. Folks say it runs all the way to HOENN, but nobody gets through that whirlpool.
The whirlpool south of ROUTE 41 has calmed! Did you see it on TV?
SURF through the gap in the rocks and follow the TIDAL STRAIT. It comes out on HOENN's ROUTE 105.
You SURFED the TIDAL STRAIT all the way to HOENN? The sailors here will be talking about that for years!
MR. BRINEY says the sea west of ROUTE 105 is calm again. The TIDAL STRAIT runs from there all the way to JOHTO!
SECRET POWER works here too, not just in HOENN. There are hollow trees in ILEX FOREST and VIRIDIAN FOREST.
And cracked rock on ROUTE 45 and inside MT. MOON. Make a SECRET BASE in one!
The old legendary sites are open again: the desert ruins, SKY PILLAR, even the caves under the sea.
The POKéMON that slept there are gone. TRAINERS are making SECRET BASES in them!
Hmph. Wild CYNDAQUIL turn up in the BURNED TOWER at night.
Go catch one if you want. Mine will still burn it to a crisp.
Hmph. Something keeps stealing a fisherman's bait at the LAKE OF RAGE.
It's a wild TOTODILE. Bring a GOOD ROD if you want it. Mine's stronger.
Hmph. There's a wild CHIKORITA in a meadow off ROUTE 46.
Follow the sweet smell by day. Mine will never lose to it.
PROF. ELM dropped by today.
He says CHIKORITA families sunbathe in a meadow off ROUTE 46.
He thought you'd like to see them, since yours started it all!
PROF. ELM dropped by today.
He says TYPHLOSION nest in the BURNED TOWER at night.
He thought you'd like to see them, since yours started it all!
PROF. ELM dropped by today.
He says a FERALIGATR raises its TOTODILE in the LAKE OF RAGE.
He thought you'd like to see them, since yours started it all!
Our lab's TOTODILE is still loose somewhere.
A fisherman at the LAKE OF RAGE keeps losing his bait. That's our guess!
It knows our lab's smell. If it sees you, it'll come to you!
Our lab's CHIKORITA is still loose somewhere.
I saw it run into the tall grass on ROUTE 46, by day.
It knows our lab's smell. If it sees you, it'll come to you!
Our lab's CYNDAQUIL is still loose somewhere.
Someone saw it by ECRUTEAK's BURNED TOWER, after dark.
It knows our lab's smell. If it sees you, it'll come to you!
The PROF. is writing about CHIKORITA on ROUTE 46.
There's a hidden meadow there. Have you seen them?
The PROF. is writing about TYPHLOSION in the BURNED TOWER.
They bring their young there at night. Have you seen them?
The PROF. is writing about a FERALIGATR in the LAKE OF RAGE.
It raises its TOTODILE in the south cove. Have you seen them?
My grandson BILL says BULBASAUR meet in a garden behind our house.
In the morning, slip through the trees above the overlook!
The NURSE keeps looking out at the rain.
She saw a CHARMANDER by NUGGET BRIDGE at dusk.
It was waiting in the rain. Its flame was so small…
PROF. OAK is said to give TRAINERS with all 16 BADGES a ticket for the ship to HOENN.
Ships leave from VERMILION's port.

STORY_NORMAN.text: NORMAN of PETALBURG only battles TRAINERS who already have four HOENN BADGES.

text: WATTSON won't battle until someone fixes the generator in NEW MAUVILLE.
He's looking for a TRAINER to help!
The MOSSDEEP GYM twins won't battle until the SPACE CENTER gets its meteorite back.
COZMO in FALLARBOR might know where one is.

STORY_WINONA.text: FORTREE's GYM LEADER WINONA has been out by the WEATHER INSTITUTE on ROUTE 119.

text: Every morning a SWAMPERT brings two MUDKIP to this pond to practice.
When they all dive, you'd better find some shelter!
Every morning, a GARDEVOIR guards a RALTS by the tall grass near PETALBURG.
Run up to them and they vanish! Walk slowly, with a POKéMON that really loves you.
Some evenings you can hear blades clashing behind the trees in the north-east corner.
TUESDAYS, THURSDAYS, SATURDAYS… the old contest days. Watch from the little path at the top of the park!
On some nights, folks here swear their own shadows grin at them.
If yours does, follow where it points. It only plays at night.
That SLOWKING down the well asks a riddle every day, a different one for each day of the week.
Solve them all and it tells you a whole prophecy. Grandpa KURT says it's about the sea.
There's a MUNCHLAX asleep in the trees by the first ash fields. It's been there for weeks!
The glassblower says he's working on something that could wake it.
Some mornings a SPINDA dances in the ash, up by the sign past the twins.
Only once a week, mind you. It's a shy one.
A SLAKING sleeps in the gap in the trees up north. NORMAN used to train back there.
It only ever gets up at noon. Then it's grumpy!
TROPIUS shakes fruit off its neck when the sun comes up.
I saw one fly into the trees under the FORTREE sign on ROUTE 119. Right into a tree!
Nobody looks twice at the fish in that little pond up the route.
Grandpa says it only bites after dark, and only on an OLD ROD.
Every Sunday night, same island on ROUTE 114's lake, same fight.
ZANGOOSE and SEVIPER. Surf out there if you dare!
The white one stands on the cliff when the storm rolls in.
On ROUTE 120, up on the ridge between the paths. Only on the stormy nights, mind you.
There's a WAILORD asleep in the rocks off ROUTE 131. Been there since spring.
It's always listening for its little ones. Saturday mornings, it nearly wakes up.
On still nights, the chimes up here ring by themselves.
Follow the sound between the graves, if you're brave enough.
Saturday mornings, you can hear singing from the top of METEOR FALLS. ALTARIA, I'd bet.
There's a way up past the first waterfall. Keep your head down behind the rocks!
A BAGON lives deep in METEOR FALLS. Every morning it jumps off a ledge, trying to fly.
It's been doing it since sunrise for weeks. It never gives up!
My husband stays at METEOR FALLS overnight. He says the meteorite pieces glow in STEVEN's cave.
Once a week, METANG gather around the glow. He's sure something happens then!
The desert sings at sunset. Honest! A low hum rolls right over the dunes.
I only ever hear it in the evening. The TRAPINCH come up out of the sand to listen.
Tracks that run into a hollow? Sand drains away there, all day long.
The old folks in FALLARBOR know every desert story. Go ask them!
The desert sand drains into a hollow, you say? It did that when I was a boy, too.
My father said it runs down under ROUTE 114, where the FOSSIL MANIAC digs. PROF. COZMO has studied it.
Desert sand that hums? It's so fine it sings when it slides. And it slides underground!
The FOSSIL MANIAC's tunnel on ROUTE 114 runs under the desert: the DESERT UNDERPASS. Try its sandy far end.
Oh my, a chime of desert sand! I haven't heard that song since I was a girl.
Ring it in the desert at sunset, dearie, and the mirage shows the way.
You saw the mirage tower? In my day, a FLYGON sang at the very top.
Its floors are cracked and crumbling. Only fast wheels get across them!
I dive off ROUTE 124 every night. After dark, the deep water there glows!
A CHINCHOU's light waits on the seabed. Swim close and it drifts away, as if it wants you to follow.
A crack in the seabed off ROUTE 124? I've never dared swim down. It's black as ink.
You'd want a POKéMON that glows on your team. A CHINCHOU or a LANTURN, say.
You went down into that trench? Then you've met its guardians. Something different waits there each day.
HUNTAIL on MONDAY, WEDNESDAY and FRIDAY. GOREBYSS on TUESDAY, THURSDAY and SATURDAY. And on SUNDAY, an old RELICANTH.
The CLAMPERL down in that trench grow pearls. Big ones!
They only open up once a week, mind you.
The deepest room of this cave is all ice. When the tide goes out, the seawater under it drains away and a hole opens in its floor.
I hear something with a face as hard as ice sits down there by day. Mind your footing on the way!
You went down through the ice? Then you've seen that GLALIE on the frozen pool.
Its head is harder than the ice it sits in. Bring something that can take a hit!
Something cold walks the ice down there when the tide is out at night.
You'll see her in the ice before you see her. Touch the wrong ice and she'll blow you right back!
That feather you found… A great ice bird passed over the sea when I was a boy.
Something like that doesn't leave its feathers lying around for nothing. Hold on to it.
Grandpa's old pine is in the meadow by the pond, at the bottom of ROUTE 45. It's tucked in behind a hedge.
Spread the HONEY low on the trunk, where a TEDDIURSA can reach!
The TEDDIURSA came for your HONEY? Don't chase them off!
If they get used to you, their mother will come and see who's been feeding her cubs.
The mother URSARING came to the pine? Then she'll be back at night.
Mother bears go walking under the moon. Grandpa says she wants to show you something!
You followed the mother up the cliff? Grandpa says the bears have watched the moon from up there since he was a boy.
When a thunderstorm hits ROUTE 10, lightning strikes our roof and the generator goes wild.
The MANAGER keeps finding odd things in the coils after a storm. Ask him next time it storms!
Did you feel that tremor? A new line of writing turned up inside the RUINS.
It's got dots on it like nothing from JOHTO. We need someone who's been to HOENN!
AT NIGHT WE SPEAK… I've been sleeping here at the lab ever since you read it.
If the WORDS chambers really light up at night, is it the same word every night? Tell my colleague what you see!
Hikers keep phoning the lab. They see UNOWN floating in a circle at night, deep in the caves.
Always somewhere quiet, away from the path. Is it the places from the words?
Items keep vanishing off the ice deep down in the ICE PATH. Only at night!
CLAIR thinks it's a POKéMON. Whatever it is, it's fast on the ice.
That SNEASEL from the ICE PATH still comes back to its corner at night.
It's lost its hoard, but it hasn't lost that grin!

before: They say CASTFORM only show themselves when the weather turns.
Look around ROUTES 119, 120 and 123 when the sky turns!
CASTFORM.after: Somebody caught a CASTFORM! So it really does ride the weather near the WEATHER INSTITUTE.
notes: Something near the WEATHER INSTITUTE changes with the sky…
It only appears when the weather turns.

before: A fisherman swears a little pond on ROUTE 119 hides a POKéMON nobody else can find.
Only after sundown, and only with the plainest rod, he says!
FEEBAS.after: So FEEBAS really lives in that pond on ROUTE 119! The first one even had a PRISM SCALE.
FEEBAS.notes: A shabby fish hides in a still pond above the falls. It only bites after sundown, on an old rod.

MASQUERAIN.before: In HOENN, MASQUERAIN only flutter out of the grass on rainy days.
MASQUERAIN.after: Somebody caught a MASQUERAIN in the rain! I knew those rainy days were worth it.
MASQUERAIN.notes: A bug with eye-patterned wings only comes out on HOENN's rainy days.

LAPRAS.before: Every Friday, a LAPRAS is said to sing deep down in UNION CAVE.
LAPRAS.after: Somebody met UNION CAVE's Friday LAPRAS! Its song is real after all.
LAPRAS.notes: Deep in a JOHTO cave, a song can be heard once a week. Which day was it…?

before: They say the only RALTS in HOENN lives on ROUTE 102, with a GARDEVOIR watching over it.
It won't let just anyone near.
RALTS.after: Someone earned that GARDEVOIR's trust! The RALTS on ROUTE 102 went with them.
notes: On a quiet HOENN route, a guardian reads the hearts of those who come near.
Come in the morning, and don't rush.

MACHAMP.before: The KARATE KING in MT. MORTAR spars with a wild MACHAMP every morning, they say.
MACHAMP.after: Somebody watched KIYO's morning match with that MACHAMP! Not a peep the whole time, I heard.
MACHAMP.notes: Deep in a JOHTO mountain, two fighters meet every morning. Watch quietly…

before: On TUESDAY, THURSDAY and SATURDAY evenings, the SCYTHER behind the NATIONAL PARK's trees duel.
They say a SCIZOR breaks it up!
SCIZOR.after: Somebody saw the NATIONAL PARK's SCIZOR! It's so fast, nobody had ever seen it properly.
SCIZOR.notes: In a JOHTO park, blades clash at dusk on the bug contest's old days.

before: They say a GENGAR hides in people's shadows at night, here in LAVENDER.
It leads you on a chase, and only the trainers it likes get to see it.
GENGAR.after: A GENGAR came out of somebody's shadow and went with them! LAVENDER's nights feel quieter now.
GENGAR.notes: In a KANTO town of quiet memorials, your shadow may laugh at night. Follow it.

before: The SLOWKING in the SLOWPOKE WELL asks one riddle a day, a new one each weekday.
Answer all seven and you'll hear its whole prophecy.
SAGE.after: Somebody heard the SLOWKING's whole prophecy! Something about lights under the sea.
SAGE.notes: A wise king in a JOHTO well asks one riddle each day of the week.

before: They say a MUNCHLAX on ROUTE 113 has been asleep so long, the ash is piling up on it.
Something sweet-sounding might wake it.
MUNCHLAX.after: Somebody woke the sleepy MUNCHLAX on ROUTE 113! There was a grotto behind it the whole time.
MUNCHLAX.notes: A sleeping glutton blocks a path in the ash. A flute of glass might wake it.

before: They say a SPINDA dances in the falling ash on ROUTE 113, on a morning once a week.
SPINDA.after: Somebody saw the dancing SPINDA on ROUTE 113! Every one of them has different spots, you know.
SPINDA.notes: In the falling ash, on a morning once a week, someone dances alone.

before: They say a SLAKING sleeps across a path in PETALBURG WOODS. It only moves when the sun is highest.
SLAKING.after: Somebody caught the SLAKING in PETALBURG WOODS! NORMAN's old training spot is open again.
SLAKING.notes: In the woods by PETALBURG, a lazy giant only stirs at noon.

before: They say there's an orchard hidden in ROUTE 119's jungle, and a TROPIUS that tends it every morning.
TROPIUS.after: Somebody found the hidden orchard on ROUTE 119! Its tree drops rare fruit every day.
TROPIUS.notes: Under the FORTREE sign on ROUTE 119, one tree is a door. Mornings, something tends fruit there.

before: They say a ZANGOOSE and a SEVIPER fight on the lake island on ROUTE 114, every Sunday night.
FEUD.after: Somebody broke up the Sunday fight on ROUTE 114's island! They'll be back next week, though.
FEUD.notes: Two old enemies meet on ROUTE 114's lake island on Sunday nights.

before: They say a white POKéMON stands over ROUTE 120 on stormy nights. Nobody's ever caught it.
ABSOL.after: Somebody saw the white one on ROUTE 120's ridge! Now it runs through the grass on stormy nights.
ABSOL.notes: On ROUTE 120's storm nights, something white watches from the ridge between the paths.

before: They say a WAILORD sleeps in a gap in the rocks on ROUTE 131, and nothing will wake it.
WAILORD.after: The sleeping WAILORD on ROUTE 131 woke up! There's an atoll past the rocks where it was.
WAILORD.notes: A WAILORD blocks a strait on ROUTE 131. It's waiting for its young on Saturday mornings.

before: They say wind chimes ring on MT. PYRE's summit at night, even when there's no wind.
CHIMECHO.after: Somebody followed the chimes on MT. PYRE's summit and found a CHIMECHO singing!
CHIMECHO.notes: Chimes ring among MT. PYRE's summit graves at night. Follow the sound.

before: They say a flock sings on a hidden cliff above METEOR FALLS, but only on SATURDAYS.
CHORUS.after: Somebody watched the ALTARIA chorus above METEOR FALLS without scaring the flock!
CHORUS.notes: An ALTARIA chorus sings above METEOR FALLS on SATURDAY mornings. Watch from behind the boulders.

before: They say a BAGON in METEOR FALLS jumps off a cliff every morning, trying to fly.
BAGON.after: The BAGON in METEOR FALLS finally got to show someone how high it can jump!
BAGON.notes: A BAGON leaps into a pool deep in METEOR FALLS every morning. Surf to its ledge.

before: They say two METANG become one at night, deep in STEVEN's cave at METEOR FALLS.
METAGROSS.after: Somebody saw two METANG fuse into a METAGROSS in STEVEN's cave!
METAGROSS.notes: Two METANG hover over a glowing rock in STEVEN's cave at night, once a week.

before: They say the ROUTE 111 desert hums like a song, but only in the evening.
DESERT_SONG.after: Somebody found what was humming under the desert: a VIBRAVA!
DESERT_SONG.notes: The ROUTE 111 desert hums in the evening. Follow the TRAPINCH that come up to listen.

before: They say a tower rises out of the ROUTE 111 sand at sunset, then fades away like a mirage.
MIRAGE_TOWER.after: Somebody climbed the mirage tower in the desert and caught a FLYGON at the top!
MIRAGE_TOWER.notes: A chime made from singing sand, rung in the ROUTE 111 desert at sunset, raises the MIRAGE TOWER. Something hums at the top.

before: They say lights dance on the seabed off ROUTE 124, but only at night.
NIGHT_DIVE.after: Somebody followed the lights off ROUTE 124 down into a hidden trench!
NIGHT_DIVE.notes: At night, a CHINCHOU's light on the seabed under ROUTE 124 leads somewhere. Bring a POKéMON that glows.

before: They say three old POKéMON guard the trench under ROUTE 124, and something sleeps behind them.
TRENCH_GUARDIANS.after: Somebody caught all three of the ROUTE 124 trench's guardians, and the mound down there opened up!
TRENCH_GUARDIANS.notes: The ROUTE 124 trench's guardian changes with the weekday. Catch all three and the mound in the trench opens.

before: They say a hole opens in the ice deep inside SHOAL CAVE, but only when the tide is out.
ICE_CHAMBER.after: Somebody climbed down through the ice in SHOAL CAVE at low tide and found a frozen chamber!
ICE_CHAMBER.notes: When the tide is out, the ice room at the bottom of SHOAL CAVE has a way down. Mind the slippery floor.

before: They say a ghost walks the ice under SHOAL CAVE at night. Her face shows in the ice, but she's never there when you look!
ICE_FROSLASS.after: Somebody chased that ghost through the ice under SHOAL CAVE. It was a FROSLASS!
ICE_FROSLASS.notes: At night, a FROSLASS's face shows in the pillars of the SHOAL CAVE ice chamber. Touch the one she's in, and only that one.

before: They say a beekeeper lives up on ROUTE 45, and the wild bears there can't resist his HONEY!
HONEY_TRAIL.after: Somebody followed an URSARING up a cliff on ROUTE 45 at night! There's a hollow up there where the bears watch the moon.
HONEY_TRAIL.notes: The beekeeper on JOHTO's ROUTE 45 gives out HONEY. Spread it on the old pine by the pond and come back in the morning. If the cubs trust you, their mother may show you the way up.

before: They say a burning shadow sometimes sweeps over the ash on ROUTE 113. The ash goes warm right before it comes!
MOLTRES_FLYOVER.after: Somebody saw a great bird of flame fly over ROUTE 113! It dropped something in the ash.
MOLTRES_FLYOVER.notes: A burning shadow crosses ROUTE 113's ash fields, heading north-west. Walk the ash east of the glass workshop.

before: Hikers say ROCK TUNNEL rumbles at night, and every night there's a fresh hole in a different wall!
Something big is digging down there. They say it's never the same wall two nights running.
ONIX_BORE.after: A trainer found a crystal ONIX resting under ROCK TUNNEL! So that's what's been digging all those holes.
ONIX_BORE.notes: At night a fresh hole opens in a different wall of ROCK TUNNEL B1F, one for each day of the week. Look along the rock faces.

before: DARK CAVE has DUNSPARCE holes, but they're never in the same place! One in the morning, one by day, one at sunset, one at night.
My dad says they're all digging toward the same spot. I want to know what's down there!
DUNSPARCE_BURROW.after: Somebody found a DUDUNSPARCE with three segments under DARK CAVE! The DUNSPARCE were digging to it all along.
DUNSPARCE_BURROW.notes: DARK CAVE's burrow holes move with the time of day: morning, day, evening and night. Each time, a different DUNSPARCE digs a little further.

before: A fisherman pal of mine says one of ROUTE 21's islets is all tangled up in vines. Nothing gets through!
He says they go limp first thing in the morning, though. Real sleepyheads, those vines!
TANGELA_VINES.after: So those vines on ROUTE 21 were TANGELA all along! Guarding something in the middle, I hear.
TANGELA_VINES.notes: The islet on ROUTE 21 nearest PALLET is wrapped in writhing vines. They only relax in the morning.

before: Evenings, we hear crying down on the BEACH. Something small and lost, I'd guess.
And a KANGASKHAN mother keeps pacing where the woods bend in, west of here. Her pouch is empty.
KANGA_BABY.after: Somebody brought a lost KANGASKHAN baby home to its mother! Now the pair nest in the woods out west.
KANGA_BABY.notes: Evenings in the FUCHSIA SAFARI ZONE, a KANGASKHAN baby cries on the BEACH. Its mother waits in a nook of the BRUSH's woods.

before: Hear that rumbling? MONDAY mornings, a TAUROS herd stampedes across the highland above the MOUNTAIN.
Each bull keeps to its own lane. The wardens say the herd's leader is no KANTO TAUROS at all!
TAUROS_STAMPEDE.after: Somebody caught the TAUROS herd's lead bull! Funny thing is, there's a new one leading them every few weeks.
TAUROS_STAMPEDE.notes: MONDAY mornings, a TAUROS herd charges across the highland above the SAFARI ZONE's MOUNTAIN, up its east canyon. Its lead bull waits beyond the herd.

before: Some days the fog over these waters is so thick, I can't see my own float.
Grandpa said the right ORB would turn that fog into a storm, and wake whatever sleeps under the SEAFOAM ISLANDS.
SEAFOAM_TITANS.after: Did you see that downpour on ROUTE 19? Rain like that only falls when something enormous wakes up.
SEAFOAM_TITANS.notes: On the days fog covers ROUTES 19 and 20, KANTO's sea caves stir for anyone carrying an ORB. The old man at MT. PYRE's summit keeps them.

before: While I wait by the boat, I see red and blue sparkles in the grass. Warm, like little embers.
The PEWTER MUSEUM knows its stones. They'd know what those are.
ENIGMA_SHARDS.after: The grove feels different since you brought that stone back. Like someone in there is listening.
ENIGMA_SHARDS.notes: Shards of a red and blue stone lie hidden on the SOUTHERN ISLAND. The PEWTER MUSEUM's stone expert can piece them together.

text: Fog is due over ROUTE 19 {STR_VAR_1}.
Odd… the rain gauges out there keep twitching anyway.
Fog is due over ROUTE 20 {STR_VAR_1}.
Strange… the SEAFOAM thermometers keep climbing.
Thunderstorms are coming to ROUTE 10's POWER PLANT {STR_VAR_1}.
The plant's manager says that's when his generator acts up!
Storms are rolling in around ROUTE 120 {STR_VAR_1}.
Folks say that's when the white one walks.
Our instruments say ROUTE 120 gets a thunderstorm {STR_VAR_1}.
CASTFORM come out in weather like that!
Our instruments say a thunderstorm reaches ROUTE 119 {STR_VAR_1}.
CASTFORM come out in weather like that!
Our instruments say heavy rain reaches ROUTE 123 {STR_VAR_1}.
CASTFORM come out in weather like that!
Rain is coming to ROUTES 101 to 104 {STR_VAR_1}.
That's when MASQUERAIN flutter out of the grass!
Rain is coming to the routes around MAUVILLE {STR_VAR_1}.
That's when MASQUERAIN flutter out of the grass!
Rain is coming to ROUTES 114 and 115 {STR_VAR_1}.
That's when MASQUERAIN flutter out of the grass!
Rain is coming to ROUTE 121 {STR_VAR_1}.
That's when MASQUERAIN flutter out of the grass!
